title: Copper Trumpet Doorbell
lead: Press the button by your door, and a Note Block on copper plays a trumpet. As the copper turns green, the tune changes!

states.label: Waiting
states.text: The doorbell is ready. The Block of Copper under the Note Block is shiny and new.

states.label: Toot!
states.text: You press the button. Power runs along the dust, and the Note Block plays a trumpet.

states.label: Copper ages
states.text: Time passes, and the copper turns green. Press again. Now it plays the Weathered Trumpet, which sounds like a trombone.

states.label: All green
states.text: Fully green copper plays the Oxidized Trumpet. It sounds like a big, buzzy trombone.

steps: Find the corner of your house next to the door.
Place 3 Stone Bricks in a row on the ground, right next to that corner.
Put a Block of Copper at the end of the row.
Put a Note Block on top of the copper. Keep the space above it empty.
Put Redstone Dust on top of each Stone Brick.
Put a Stone Button on the front of the corner block, level with the dust. Press it!
how: A Stone Button powers the block it is on for 1 second. That block powers the dust beside it. The power runs along the dust into the Note Block, and it plays. The block under a Note Block picks its sound, and copper makes a trumpet.
tips: A Note Block only plays if the space right above it is empty.
Each copper stage plays a different trumpet. Wax the copper with a Honeycomb, and it stays the same forever.
Use the Note Block to make its note one step higher. There are 25 notes. After the highest one, it goes back to the lowest.
Copper trumpets came to Minecraft in the Tiny Takeover drop in March 2026.
